_doc: Which environment variable belongs on which Railway service. Names and rules only: no value, no id, no hostname (this repository is public).
Derived from apps/api/src/config/runtime-config.ts (+ parse-env.ts, live-timings.ts, runtime/worker-role.ts) and apps/web's process.env reads; where docs/railway-deploy.md disagreed, the code won.
services: the four deployable services. api = the HTTP api (IS_WORKER unset); worker-copy = IS_WORKER=true WORKER_ROLE=copy; worker-read = IS_WORKER=true WORKER_ROLE=read; web = the Next.js server.

variables.<NAME>.services: the services that use the variable, each `required` (the service refuses to start or is unusable without it) or `optional` (a default applies). A service missing from `services` does not use the variable: setting it there is reported as forbidden (unused) by scripts/ops/services-manifest.mjs.
variables.<NAME>.forbidden: services where the variable must NOT be set, with the reason: `refused` (startup throws), `secret` (a credential the service never uses) or `unused`.
variables.<NAME>.sameAs: services whose value must be identical. variables.<NAME>.rule: a constraint the statuses cannot express (value-dependent requirements, ordering).

retired: names no code reads any more; present anywhere = forbidden. platform: names Railway, Node or the image set, never flagged (scripts/ops/services-manifest.test.mjs allow-lists them for the code-vs-manifest check).
Checked by scripts/ops/services-manifest.test.mjs (every name here is read in code, every runtime-config.ts read is here) and applied by scripts/ops/services-manifest.mjs (read-only, names only).

api.description: HTTP api: IS_WORKER unset, no WORKER_ROLE; one image with the workers (apps/api/Dockerfile).

worker-copy.description: Copy worker: IS_WORKER=true, WORKER_ROLE=copy; live engine, setups, stops, trade feed, fast source.

worker-read.description: Read worker: IS_WORKER=true, WORKER_ROLE=read; scheduler, discovery, cohorts, archive, retention, outbox, Telegram bot, paper copy.

web.description: Next.js server (Railpack build); reads NEXT_* at build time (NEXT_PUBLIC_*) and run time.

platform.PORT: set by Railway per service; the api listens on it (WORKER_PORT wins on a worker beside an api on one machine)
platform.RAILWAY_*: Railway's own metadata (service, environment, deployment ids); read by no application code
platform.CI: set by GitHub Actions; only apps/web/playwright.config.ts reads it
platform.PLAYWRIGHT_*: apps/web/playwright.config.ts: the browser test runner's port, bundler and heap; never set on Railway
platform.TEST_DATABASE_URL: the api test suite's disposable database (scripts/test-database.mjs); never on Railway
platform.NEXT_PORT: apps/web/scripts/dev.mjs: the local dev server's port; `next start --port` is the Railway start command's

retired.COPY_LIVE_TEST_MIN_FLOOR_MAX_USD: the test floor was retired (decision D6, 2026-10-23); no code reads it, a leftover value is ignored
retired.APP_ROLE: replaced by IS_WORKER (2026-10-04); a set APP_ROLE that disagrees with IS_WORKER refuses startup, one that agrees is tolerated only so a deploy can switch image and variables in either order: delete it

NODE_ENV.purpose: development | test | staging | production; staging and production enable the production-grade checks (strong secrets, HYPERLIQUID_EGRESS_KEY required)

IS_WORKER.purpose: true makes the process a worker (background jobs, health port only); unset is the HTTP api

forbidden.api: unused: the api is the process without it (a literal `false` is tolerated; unset is the documented state)

WORKER_ROLE.purpose: copy | read (unset = all, the single worker): what a worker runs and which lease it holds

forbidden.api: refused: `WORKER_ROLE applies to the worker only (IS_WORKER=true)`

WORKER_ROLE.rule: worker-copy sets `copy`, worker-read sets `read`; both unset would make two `all` workers fight over one lease

WORKER_PORT.purpose: a worker's listen port when it runs beside an api on one machine (local); Railway sets PORT per service instead

WORKER_URL.purpose: the copy worker's internal base URL: the api reads its heartbeat (feed, copy health); GET /health is 503 without it

WORKER_READ_URL.purpose: the read worker's internal base URL: the api merges its heartbeat (snapshots, sweeps, discovery, archive, meter, egress identity)
WORKER_READ_URL.rule: set once worker-read exists (rollout step 2); without it snapshots_stale alerts after 15 min

API_SETUP_DRIVE.purpose: local (default): the api drives a copy setup inside confirm/advance; worker: it marks the setup due and wakes the copy worker (NOTIFY copy_setup_due)
API_SETUP_DRIVE.rule: switch to `worker` only after worker-copy runs with WORKER_ROLE=copy (rollout step 5); switch back to `local` before a worker becomes `all` again

DATABASE_URL.purpose: PostgreSQL connection string (postgres:// or postgresql://, with a database name)

forbidden.web: secret: the web reaches the api over HTTP only

DATABASE_URL.rule: the workers' value must be the api's exact string: /health/monitor answers only the key the api derives from it (runtime/worker-calls.ts)

DATABASE_POOL_MAX.purpose: main pool size (2..200); default per process: api 10, copy 20, read 10, all 30 (config/constants/database.ts)
DATABASE_POOL_MAX.rule: the sum plus a rolling deploy must stay under Postgres max_connections (docs/railway-deploy.md, Database connections)

AUTH_SERVICE_TOKEN.purpose: server-to-server bearer token for the api's service callers; 32+ non-placeholder characters in staging/production

forbidden.worker-copy: secret: no user API on a worker
forbidden.worker-read: secret: no user API on a worker
forbidden.web: secret: never given to the web

AUTH_SERVICE_PERMISSIONS.purpose: comma-separated permissions of AUTH_SERVICE_TOKEN (never users.manage or settings.write)

AUTH_ADMIN_EMAILS.purpose: comma-separated emails that become admin on first sign-in

PRIVY_APP_ID.purpose: the environment's Privy app (sign-in, wallets, agent signing); set together with PRIVY_APP_SECRET
PRIVY_APP_ID.rule: required by code on every process whose COPY_TRADING_MODE is testnet or live (agent signing requires Privy credentials); the web's NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_APP_ID is the same app id

PRIVY_APP_SECRET.purpose: the Privy app secret; set together with PRIVY_APP_ID

forbidden.web: secret: the web uses the public app id only

PRIVY_APP_SECRET.rule: as PRIVY_APP_ID: required wherever COPY_TRADING_MODE is testnet or live

PRIVY_VERIFICATION_KEY.purpose: ES256 public key that verifies users' Privy tokens on the api; requires PRIVY_APP_ID

PRIVY_AGENT_AUTHORIZATION_KEY.purpose: base64 P256 PKCS8 private key that signs copy execution through Privy; set together with PRIVY_AGENT_WORKER_QUORUM_ID

forbidden.web: secret: signing never happens in the web

PRIVY_AGENT_AUTHORIZATION_KEY.rule: a process with COPY_TRADING_MODE=testnet|live refuses to start without it (the api signs setups under API_SETUP_DRIVE=local); worker-read never signs, so it needs the key only if it also carries COPY_TRADING_MODE=live

PRIVY_AGENT_WORKER_QUORUM_ID.purpose: the Privy key quorum of PRIVY_AGENT_AUTHORIZATION_KEY

ACCOUNT_DELETION_MARKER_KEY.purpose: HMAC key of the deleted-identity hashes (users/deletion-markers.ts); unset derives one from PRIVY_APP_SECRET; 32+ characters in staging/production

forbidden.worker-copy: secret: deletion markers are written by the api
forbidden.worker-read: secret: deletion markers are written by the api

ACCOUNT_DELETION_MARKER_PREVIOUS_KEYS.purpose: comma-separated retired marker keys kept for the retention window after a rotation

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.purpose: the environment's alerts/linking bot; alerts are sent from every process, the link flow (GET /me/telegram) needs it on the api
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.rule: one bot per environment (D2); requires TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME

TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME.purpose: the bot's username (5..32 word characters, no @); required whenever TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is set

TELEGRAM_BOT_POLLING.purpose: whether this process polls the bot for updates (default true)
TELEGRAM_BOT_POLLING.rule: only one process may poll a token (Telegram answers 409 to a second poller): worker-read polls, so set `false` on the api and worker-copy when they carry the token

TELEGRAM_DRY_RUN.purpose: true (default) logs messages instead of sending; false requires TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN

TELEGRAM_SYSTEM_CHAT_ID.purpose: chat that receives system notices; unset = log only

TELEGRAM_LINK_BASE_URL.purpose: site origin used in bot links (http/https URL)

ALERT_MAX_ACTION_AGE_SECONDS.purpose: actions older than this are not alerted on (1..86400)

HYPERLIQUID_EGRESS_KEY.purpose: the shared Hyperliquid REST meter's key (one value per outbound IP; letters, digits, : . _ -); required in staging and production
HYPERLIQUID_EGRESS_KEY.rule: must not contain a `read` segment: `<key>:read` is the read worker's own derived meter (HYPERLIQUID_READ_METER=own)

HYPERLIQUID_READ_METER.purpose: own (default): worker-read charges its own meter `<HYPERLIQUID_EGRESS_KEY>:read` (cap 900, reserve 300); shared: back on the copy side's meter (the D12 rollback)

forbidden.api: refused: `HYPERLIQUID_READ_METER applies to the read worker only`
forbidden.worker-copy: refused: `HYPERLIQUID_READ_METER applies to the read worker only`

HYPERLIQUID_BACKGROUND_REST_CAP.purpose: what background work may hold of the shared per-IP REST window (0..1200, default 840); lowered on a mainnet copy canary

forbidden.worker-read: refused under HYPERLIQUID_READ_METER=own: the read meter's cap is the constant READ_WORKER_BACKGROUND_REST_CAP (delete it, or set HYPERLIQUID_READ_METER=shared)

HYPERLIQUID_WEIGHT_BUDGET_PER_MIN.purpose: this process's REST weight rate per minute (1..1199; api default 840)
HYPERLIQUID_WEIGHT_BUDGET_PER_MIN.rule: worker-copy on HYPERLIQUID_NETWORK=mainnet ignores it: a mainnet worker reads HYPERLIQUID_WORKER_WEIGHT_BUDGET_PER_MIN (default MAINNET_WORKER_WEIGHT 360). worker-read under its own meter may lower the 900 default, never raise it. api + worker-copy rates must add up to HYPERLIQUID_BACKGROUND_REST_CAP

HYPERLIQUID_WEIGHT_BURST.purpose: this process's REST weight burst (1..1200; api default 200)
HYPERLIQUID_WEIGHT_BURST.rule: as HYPERLIQUID_WEIGHT_BUDGET_PER_MIN: a mainnet worker-copy reads HYPERLIQUID_WORKER_WEIGHT_BURST (default 840) instead; worker-read may only lower its 900

HYPERLIQUID_WORKER_WEIGHT_BUDGET_PER_MIN.purpose: a worker's REST rate when it shares the api's .env (local) and always on a mainnet worker (default MAINNET_WORKER_WEIGHT.perMin 360)

HYPERLIQUID_WORKER_WEIGHT_BURST.purpose: a worker's REST burst when it shares the api's .env (local) and always on a mainnet worker (default MAINNET_WORKER_WEIGHT.burst 840)

HYPERLIQUID_PAGE_RESERVE_SHARE.purpose: share of the rate the page reserve keeps refilling at while page work is over its share (0.05..0.9, default 0.25)

HYPERLIQUID_STARTUP_PACE_SECONDS.purpose: a new process sends at a reduced rate from empty buckets for this long, so a redeploy overlapping the old instance does not double the spend (0..600, default 60)

HYPERLIQUID_API_URL.purpose: Hyperliquid info REST endpoint for discovery reads (default mainnet)

HYPERLIQUID_NETWORK.purpose: mainnet | testnet (default testnet): where users' wallets live and where every actual copy executes
HYPERLIQUID_NETWORK.rule: COPY_TRADING_MODE=live requires mainnet, =testnet requires testnet; every Railway environment is mainnet (D1)

HYPERLIQUID_ARBITRUM_RPC_URL.purpose: Arbitrum RPC for wallet balances and bridge reads (http/https); default the network's public endpoint

HYPERLIQUID_POOL_LEDGER_WEIGHT_PER_MIN.purpose: tuning: the pool's trade-ledger builds (0..600, default 100; 0 pauses)
HYPERLIQUID_POOL_LEDGER_WEIGHT_PER_MIN.rule: the read worker runs the job; the api reads the tuning names only to show them

HYPERLIQUID_POOL_PERFORMANCE_WEIGHT_PER_.purpose: tuning: the pool's portfolio reads (0..600, default 240)

DISCOVERY_LEADERBOARD_REFRESH_MINUTES.purpose: tuning: official leaderboard import interval (5..240, default 15)

DISCOVERY_CANDIDATE_POOL_SIZE.purpose: tuning: pool size, plus every KOL (50..5000, default 1000)

DISCOVERY_COHORT_MEMBERS_PER_TIER.purpose: tuning: members per cohort tier (0..2000, default 500)

DISCOVERY_COHORT_REFRESH_MINUTES.purpose: tuning: cohort member refresh interval (5..240, default 40)

RETENTION_ENABLED.purpose: tuning: the daily retention job (default true)

RETENTION_AUDIT_DAYS.purpose: tuning: admin audit rows kept (30..3650, default 365)

RETENTION_QUEUE_DAYS.purpose: tuning: finished outbox rows kept (7..3650, default 30)

RETENTION_ALERT_DAYS.purpose: tuning: alert delivery records kept (7..3650, default 30)

RETENTION_COPY_EQUITY_FULL_DAYS.purpose: tuning: paper copy valuations at full resolution (31..3650, default 31)

RETENTION_COHORT_MEMBER_LIST_DAYS.purpose: tuning: cohort history member lists kept (7..3650, default 30)

RETENTION_FOLLOWER_OBSERVATION_DAYS.purpose: tuning: superseded follower observations kept (1..3650, default 7)

RETENTION_HISTORY_FILL_DAYS.purpose: tuning: traders' stored fill history (30..3650, default 90); the archive backfill never goes further back

COPY_TRADING_MODE.purpose: paper (default) | disabled | testnet | live: the deployment's copy capability; testnet/live also execute real orders on HYPERLIQUID_NETWORK
COPY_TRADING_MODE.rule: live requires HYPERLIQUID_NETWORK=mainnet, PRIVY_AGENT_AUTHORIZATION_KEY + PRIVY_AGENT_WORKER_QUORUM_ID, HYPERLIQUID_EGRESS_KEY and COPY_LIVE_ALLOWED_PRIVY_USER_IDS on that process; the api and worker-copy must agree. worker-read runs paper copy only, but if it carries `live` the same requirements apply to it

COPY_LIVE_ALLOWED_PRIVY_USER_IDS.purpose: comma-separated did:privy: ids who may copy with real funds; required with COPY_TRADING_MODE=live

COPY_LIVE_MAX_STRATEGIES_PER_USER.purpose: actual copies one owner may hold (1..50, default 2)

COPY_LIVE_MAX_ALLOCATION_USD.purpose: largest budget of one copy, top-ups included (1..10000000; unset: the risk policy's alone)

COPY_LIVE_MAX_LEVERAGE.purpose: highest leverage a copy may use (1..50; live default 3)

COPY_LIVE_FIXED_PER_TRADE_MIN_USD.purpose: testnet only: fixed sizing's per-trade lower bound (11..1000000); set together with _MAX_USD
COPY_LIVE_FIXED_PER_TRADE_MIN_USD.rule: ignored under COPY_TRADING_MODE=live (ratio sizing only, D6): a leftover from the fixed-amount trial can be deleted

COPY_LIVE_FIXED_PER_TRADE_MAX_USD.purpose: testnet only: fixed sizing's per-trade upper bound (11..1000000); set together with _MIN_USD

COPY_LIVE_TESTNET_SOURCE_INTERVAL_MS.purpose: how often a testnet leader's fills are polled over REST (1000..600000, default 60000)

COPY_TESTNET_MAX_PRICE_DEVIATION_BPS.purpose: largest mid difference between the leader's network and the execution network at which an open is still mirrored (0..10000, default 500)

COPY_LIVE_TESTNET_EVIDENCE_MAX_AGE_MS.purpose: testnet only: the live path's evidence window (5000..10000)

forbidden.api: refused when HYPERLIQUID_NETWORK=mainnet (every Railway environment is): `is testnet only`

COPY_LIVE_SLIPPAGE_BPS.purpose: IOC limit distance from the execution network's mid (0..500, default 30)

COPY_LIVE_INTERVAL_MS.purpose: one live worker pass every this many ms (1000..60000, default 3000)

COPY_LIVE_WEIGHT_PER_MIN.purpose: testnet REST weight per minute for execution reads (100..485, default 300); the api and the worker refuse to start above 485

COPY_LIVE_REVOKE_DEADLINE_MINUTES.purpose: how long a grant whose revocation an admin requested stays usable for its copy's stop (1..1440, default 30)

COPY_LIVE_FAST_SOURCE.purpose: mainnet leaders whose copy signal comes from the realtime fast source: `all` or comma-separated 0x addresses; unset = watcher-verified source

COPY_LIVE_FAST_SOURCE_GRACE_MS.purpose: how far before a read was sent it certifies fills (0..60000); read only with COPY_LIVE_FAST_SOURCE

COPY_LIVE_SETUP_LEASE_MS.rule: the step budgets must fit the lease; the api drives setups under API_SETUP_DRIVE=local, worker-copy under `worker`

COPY_LIVE_SETUP_RESERVE_WAIT_MS.purpose: a setup step's reserve wait budget (1000..300000)

COPY_LIVE_SETUP_BACKOFF_BASE_MS.purpose: a setup retry's base backoff (100..600000); must not exceed _BACKOFF_MAX_MS

COPY_LIVE_SETUP_TRANSIENT_ATTEMPTS.purpose: transient-error attempts of a setup step (1..100)

COPY_LIVE_STOP_SYSTEM_CHECK_MS.purpose: the stop worker's system check interval (1000..3600000)

COPY_WORKER_INTERVAL_MS.purpose: the paper copy worker's pass interval (250..60000, default 2000)

HL_EGRESS_IDENTITY.purpose: off (default) | observe | enforce: the egress identity guard (runtime/egress-identity.ts)
HL_EGRESS_IDENTITY.rule: `enforce` is refused on the api and meaningful on worker-copy only; it needs HL_EGRESS_PEERS

HL_EGRESS_IDENTITY_INTERVAL_MINUTES.purpose: how often the public IP is re-learned (1..1440, default 5)

HL_EGRESS_ECHO_TIMEOUT_MS.purpose: one IP echo call's bound (500..10000, default 3000)

HL_EGRESS_ECHO_URLS.purpose: comma-separated https IP echoes tried in order; default three independent echoes

HL_EGRESS_PEERS.purpose: the api's and worker-read's internal base URLs whose GET /health/egress reports their IPs; required under HL_EGRESS_IDENTITY=enforce

HL_EGRESS_EXPECTED_IPS.purpose: comma-separated IPv4 addresses of the static egress gateway; an IP outside them refuses the lease under enforce

S3_ARCHIVE_ENABLED.purpose: true runs the S3 archive ingest (requires AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID + AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, or S3_ARCHIVE_LOCAL_DIR)

S3_ARCHIVE_LOCAL_DIR.purpose: read archive objects from a local folder instead of S3 (tests and local runs)

S3_ARCHIVE_START.purpose: earliest UTC day the archive has, YYYY-MM-DD (default 2025-05-25)

S3_ARCHIVE_MAX_DAILY_USD.purpose: cap on one UTC day's downloads (0..1000, default 2)

S3_ARCHIVE_USD_PER_GB.purpose: the transfer price the daily cap counts with (0..10, default 0.114)

S3_ARCHIVE_TRUST.purpose: regular (default) | all | none: which REST history streams may skip ranges the archive certifies

S3_ARCHIVE_BACKFILL_ENABLED.purpose: false runs only the forward cursor (default true)

S3_ARCHIVE_BACKFILL_DAYS.purpose: how far back a backfill pass goes (1..3650, default 90)

S3_ARCHIVE_PASS_INTERVAL_HOURS.purpose: least time between two backfill passes (0..8760, default 168)

S3_ARCHIVE_SETTLE_MINUTES.purpose: minutes after an hour ends before its object is read (0..1440, default 20)

S3_ARCHIVE_MAX_FILLS_PER_ADDRESS_HOUR.purpose: more fills than this in one hourly object excludes the address (0 = never, default 0)

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.purpose: the requester-pays IAM user billed for archive downloads; set together with AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY

forbidden.api: secret: the archive ingest runs on worker-read only
forbidden.worker-copy: secret: the archive ingest runs on worker-read only

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.rule: a separate IAM user per environment (D2)

forbidden.api: secret: the archive ingest runs on worker-read only
forbidden.worker-copy: secret: the archive ingest runs on worker-read only

AWS_SESSION_TOKEN.purpose: session token of temporary AWS credentials

API_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS.purpose: comma-separated explicit addresses or CIDRs allowed to set the client address

API_CORS_ORIGINS.purpose: comma-separated exact HTTP(S) origins allowed to call the api from a browser; empty = none

API_INGRESS_PER_MINUTE.purpose: rate limit: requests per minute per client (default 3000)

API_EXPENSIVE_PER_MINUTE.purpose: rate limit: expensive calls per minute (default 10)

MAX_FAVORITES_PER_USER.purpose: default favorites cap when the admin setting is unset (1..10000, default 100)

STREAM_MAX_PER_IP.purpose: live feed connections per IP (1..1000, default 8); must not exceed STREAM_MAX_TOTAL

STREAM_MAX_TOTAL.purpose: live feed connections in total (1..100000, default 500)

STREAM_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS.purpose: proxy hops in front of the api (0..10; Railway 1)

NEXT_API_URL.purpose: the api's internal base URL the web server forwards /api/hl/* to and prefetches from (server side only)

NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL.purpose: canonical origin for metadataBase and Open Graph URLs (compiled in at build time)

NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_APP_ID.purpose: the Privy app id the browser signs in with (compiled in); unset disables the login button
NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_APP_ID.rule: the same app as the api's PRIVY_APP_ID

NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_NAME.purpose: product name in titles and the wordmark (compiled in; default Orbie)

NEXT_PUBLIC_API_FIXTURES.purpose: 1 answers api calls from bundled fixtures instead of the api (compiled in; dev and tests)
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_FIXTURES.rule: never `1` on Railway: a deployed build would serve demo data

NEXT_PUBLIC_CJK_FONT_BUILD.purpose: the CJK web font generation id both bundles inline (cookie invalidation); default local-test

NEXT_PRIVY_AUTH_ORIGINS.purpose: comma-separated extra Privy origins allowed by the CSP (read at run time)

CLIENT_IP_HEADER.purpose: the request header holding the visitor's address as the edge sets it (default x-forwarded-for)

NEXT_TEST_MODE.purpose: 1 starts the browser-test server (fixtures, Privy stub, no root .env)

forbidden.web: unused: test server only; a deployed web must never run in test mode

NEXT_DEV_LAB.purpose: 1 opens the /dev lab on a production build

forbidden.web: unused: the dev lab is a developer tool, never open on a deployed web

NEXT_PUBLIC_CJK_WARMUP.purpose: 1 runs the CJK font warm-up under fixtures (tests)
